title: Mobile world readability and combat hierarchy
repairs: Tracked objective edge marker avoids reserved HUD geometry instead of covering controls.
Contextual target button communicates HAFEN only when a real nearby port exists; otherwise it remains ZIEL.
Safe-zone copy no longer implies that global Shipyard requires docking.
Touch HUD keeps the circular combat cluster as the primary action surface and does not introduce a second permanent rectangular action rail.
Tracked target remains emphasized on the minimap with a dedicated ring while generic POI density stays budgeted.
